scripts.info: echo 'AM Core Services Monorepo' && echo 'Layers: libraries, domain, services'
scripts.build:compile: node scripts/run-with-logs.js mvn clean compile -s maven-settings.xml
scripts.build:all: node scripts/run-with-logs.js mvn clean install -s maven-settings.xml -DskipTests
scripts.core:dev: node scripts/run-with-logs.js npx -y concurrently -n "gateway,analysis,mcp" -c "cyan,magenta,yellow" "npm run gateway:dev" "npm run analysis:dev" "npm run mcp:dev"
scripts.libs:compile: node scripts/run-with-logs.js npx -y dotenv-cli -e .env -- python scripts/mvn_build.py libraries/
scripts.domain:compile: node scripts/run-with-logs.js npx -y dotenv-cli -e .env -- python scripts/mvn_build.py domain/
scripts.services:compile: node scripts/run-with-logs.js npx -y dotenv-cli -e .env -- python scripts/mvn_build.py services/
scripts.gateway:dev: node scripts/run-with-logs.js npx -y dotenv-cli -e services/am-gateway/.env -- mvn spring-boot:run -pl services/am-gateway -s maven-settings.xml -Dspring-boot.run.profiles=dev
scripts.gateway:preprod: node scripts/run-with-logs.js npx -y dotenv-cli -e services/am-gateway/.env.preprod -- mvn spring-boot:run -pl services/am-gateway -s maven-settings.xml -Dspring-boot.run.profiles=preprod
scripts.gateway:prod: node scripts/run-with-logs.js npx -y dotenv-cli -e services/am-gateway/.env.prod -- mvn spring-boot:run -pl services/am-gateway -s maven-settings.xml -Dspring-boot.run.profiles=prod
scripts.analysis:dev: node scripts/run-with-logs.js npx -y dotenv-cli -e services/am-analysis/.env -- mvn spring-boot:run -pl services/am-analysis -s maven-settings.xml -Dspring-boot.run.profiles=dev
scripts.analysis:preprod: node scripts/run-with-logs.js npx -y dotenv-cli -e services/am-analysis/.env.preprod -- mvn spring-boot:run -pl services/am-analysis -s maven-settings.xml -Dspring-boot.run.profiles=preprod
scripts.analysis:prod: node scripts/run-with-logs.js npx -y dotenv-cli -e services/am-analysis/.env.prod -- mvn spring-boot:run -pl services/am-analysis -s maven-settings.xml -Dspring-boot.run.profiles=prod
scripts.mcp:dev: node scripts/run-with-logs.js npx -y dotenv-cli -e services/am-mcp-server/.env -- mvn spring-boot:run -pl services/am-mcp-server -s maven-settings.xml -Dspring-boot.run.profiles=dev
scripts.mcp:preprod: node scripts/run-with-logs.js npx -y dotenv-cli -e services/am-mcp-server/.env.preprod -- mvn spring-boot:run -pl services/am-mcp-server -s maven-settings.xml -Dspring-boot.run.profiles=preprod
scripts.mcp:prod: node scripts/run-with-logs.js npx -y dotenv-cli -e services/am-mcp-server/.env.prod -- mvn spring-boot:run -pl services/am-mcp-server -s maven-settings.xml -Dspring-boot.run.profiles=prod
